title: Instant Noodle Okonomiyaki: Cabbage and Egg Pancakes with Sriracha Mayo
changes_from_base: Soaked instant noodles and a seasoned egg mix with soy and sesame oil replace the flour batter, the pancakes are cooked small in a lidded pan and flipped with a plate, and sriracha and mayonnaise stand in for the tangy brown sauce.
summary: Crispy, eggy pancakes filled with instant noodles and shredded cabbage, finished with spicy mayo and sesame seeds.
equipment: 15-20 cm non-stick frying pan with a lid

ingredients.item: packets instant ramen noodles (about 85 g each), flavour sachets thrown away
fine sea salt or table salt
green, red or savoy cabbage (about half a medium head), cored and thinly sliced
vegetable or sunflower oil, for frying

steps.title: Soften noodles
steps.text: Put the instant ramen noodles (discarding the flavour sachets) into a large heatproof bowl, pour over 1400 ml of just-boiled water and leave them to soak for 7–8 min.

steps.title: Mix batter
steps.text: Whisk the large eggs in a large bowl with soy sauce (or tamari), toasted sesame oil, three quarters of the sliced spring onions, salt and ground white pepper.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Drain the softened noodles well and loosen them with tongs, add them to the egg mixture along with the thinly sliced cabbage and toss everything together until well coated.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat the small non-stick frying pan over medium-high, add a little oil and a quarter of the mixture, tucking in the edges with a flexible spatula, turn the heat to medium, put a lid on and cook for 3–4 min until the underside turns golden.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Remove the lid, place a slightly larger plate over the pan and in one confident move turn the pan and plate upside down together, then slide the pancake back into the pan with the cooked side now facing upwards and cook uncovered for another 3–4 min until the egg is set completely through to the centre.

steps.title: Keep warm
steps.text: Set this one aside and repeat the frying process with the remaining three portions, wiping out the pan and adding a little fresh oil each time.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Drizzle with sriracha and mayonnaise in zigzag lines and scatter over the white sesame seeds and the reserved spring onion slices.

tips: Drain the noodles thoroughly after soaking—excess moisture will steam the pancake and make it soggy instead of crispy.
Use a slightly larger plate than the pan so you have something stable to hold when you flip; then turn with real conviction in one smooth motion.
To check the egg is set through, insert a skewer or fine knife into the centre—it should come out with no uncooked egg clinging to it.
safety: Frying safety: use a heavy, deep pot no more than half full of oil, with a clip-on thermometer, and dry the food before it goes in. Never leave hot oil unattended. If the oil catches fire, turn off the heat and cover the pot with a metal lid or use a fire extinguisher; never use water.
storage: Make up to 1 day ahead and reheat gently in the non-stick pan over medium heat until warmed through. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
